description: List Proxmox QEMU and LXC guests, optionally filtered by node, status, or type

endpoint.description: Proxmox endpoint name from config (optional when exactly one is configured)

node.description: Only guests on this Proxmox node (optional)

status.description: Only guests with this status, such as running or stopped (optional)

type.description: Only guests of this type: qemu or lxc (optional)

name: proxmox_guests
